description: Count, for every point, the other input points weakly dominated in all three coordinates using CDQ divide and conquer and a Fenwick tree.

source.title: CDQ Divide and Conquer — 3D Partial Order
source.algorithm_attribution: Sort points in the first coordinate, divide recursively, merge cross-half pairs by the second coordinate, and use a Fenwick prefix sum in the third coordinate.

contract.operation: For each input point i, count every other input index j whose x, y, and z coordinates are each no greater than the corresponding coordinate of i.
contract.duplicate_semantics: Identical coordinate triples count with multiplicity, excluding only the point's own input index.
contract.primary_method: Group identical triples, sort unique triples lexicographically, then CDQ-cross-count by y while a multiplicity-weighted Fenwick tree answers z-prefix sums.
contract.independent_method: For each input point, scan every other input index and compare all three coordinates directly.

output.encoding: weighted sum of one-based input indices and per-point weak-dominance counts

workspace.meaning: Fixed point groups, original-to-group mapping, y-merge order arrays, compressed-z values, Fenwick tree, and per-group counts.
